component.name: tastytrade Desktop 2.0
component.summary: Trading platform for stocks, options, and futures

description.p: This community package is maintained independently of tastytrade. It installs the vendor's unmodified desktop application from its official Linux download.
tastytrade Desktop 2.0 is a trading platform for viewing markets, managing an account, and trading stocks, options and futures. A tastytrade account is required to sign in.

Sound is optional and disabled by default. Enable it with flatpak override --user --socket=pulseaudio com.tastytrade.Tastytrade. Disable it again with flatpak override --user --nosocket=pulseaudio com.tastytrade.Tastytrade.

To allow notifications, run flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.Notifications com.tastytrade.Tastytrade. To disable direct notification access again, run flatpak override --user --no-talk-name=org.freedesktop.Notifications com.tastytrade.Tastytrade.
